normalized.result: Version A preserves skimmability better, so let's go with that. A long note shown in full (version B) makes that one card tower over the others and pushes everything else down, which fights the whole point of a list I can skim quickly. Version A shows a sensible preview of the note and lets me tap "Show full note" when I actually want the rest, then "Show less" to tidy it back up — so my collection stays scannable but the full note is never more than one click away. Both keep the formatting intact, and your assumption is right that the complete note must always stay reachable from the card. A is the better fit.
